# Term Deposit Rates

Open a NAB Term Deposit and start saving today.

Rates effective as of Monday,  9 November 2026.

Explore term deposits

## Key information

This document forms part of the product disclosure statement for each of the products listed in this document along with the product disclosure statement including terms and conditions for the relevant product. If you would like a copy of these documents, contact us.

## About NAB Term Deposits

A term deposit lets you lock in a high interest rate, while choosing a term to suit your specific needs. With a NAB Term Deposit you:

-   can open a term deposit with $5,000 or more
    

-   can choose a fixed term to suit your needs - from 30 days to five years 
    
-   pay no application or monthly account fees.
    

The interest is calculated daily and paid when your term deposit matures. For terms of 12 months or more, you can choose to have your interest paid monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or annually – whichever works best for you.

Find out more about NAB Term Deposits.

Please note that terms greater than 2 years, for new NAB Term Deposits, are only available through our online application form for individual customers. You may only rollover an existing term deposit, for a term greater than 2 years, using the self-serve channel on Internet Banking or the NAB App, subject to eligibility. Opening or rolling over a term deposit, for a term greater than 2 years, is not available in branch or via phone.

## Ready to apply?

For term deposits equal to or greater than $2 Million please contact your NAB banker, NAB branch, call us from the NAB app or or call 13 22 65.

Request a call back

## Term Deposit Fees and Charges

With your NAB Term Deposit there are no set up or monthly service fees.

If you choose to withdraw from your term deposit before the end of its term, you’ll need to give us 31 days’ notice. It’s also important to note that this can affect the interest we pay you.

For more information view our NAB Term Deposit Terms and Conditions.

## Managing your Term Deposit

Managing your NAB Term Deposit is easy. Whether you’re reinvesting your term deposit online, amending your maturity instructions or looking to withdraw your funds early, we’re here to help.

Find out more about managing your rollover.
